verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that https://doc.moq.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Media over QUIC table of contents linking to doc pages, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Per-page markdown docs also appear to exist (e.g. concept/transport.md), though the root .md probe returned 404. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing or promoting agent-oriented usage, a working markdown variant for the docs root, and independent or hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://doc.moq.dev/llms.txt # Media over QUIC
